_comment: Copy this file to quinn_config.json and fill in your values. quinn_config.json is gitignored.
_token_note: Your Discord user token (the same one in config.json works). Never commit this.
_bridge_note: Leave blank — quinn_discord.py reads QuinnBridge/bridge/bridge_token.txt automatically.
_tavern_note: Path to SillyTavern's start script, relative to the repo root. Adjust if yours differs.
_channels_note: IDs of guilds/channels Quinn watches. Empty = all (only safe in a private server).
_respond_note: respond_to_mentions: reply when @-mentioned in any watched guild.
_timeout_note: How long to wait for SillyTavern to finish generating before giving up.
_typing_note: Realistic typing delay after generation finishes. Rate is seconds per character.
_dry_run_note: true = Quinn reads and logs messages but never sends replies. Good for testing.
_log_note: DEBUG shows every poll cycle. INFO is normal. WARNING is quiet.
